responsibility: This header declares the constructor-container API used to manipulate gfc_constructor trees for array and structure constructors. It exposes creation, copying, destruction, insertion/appending, lookup by element offset, iteration, and removal operations over the splay-tree-backed constructor representation shared throughout the front end.
same_name_distinction: Defines the callable interface for manipulating constructor trees across the front end. Unlike gcc/fortran/constructor.cc, it is limited to declarations of constructor operations and exposes no storage-management implementation.
